completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

active_mission.title: Hixton 10+5 shared-capital architecture
active_mission.objective: Validate the short-horizon gap-filler architecture: Satellites use only free capacity, one reference slot each, never preempt an open Core, and may be exited when a materially stronger new Core opportunity clears point-in-time remaining value plus costs. Then continue automatically into Step 6 robustness if Step 5B passes.
constraints: Step 4 entry profiles remain frozen: SUIUSDC, NEARUSDC, UNIUSDC, AAVEUSDC, BCHUSDC.
Satellites are short-horizon gap-fillers, not a second primary strategy.
In Step 5B each Satellite can consume at most one reference slot and only when capacity is free.
Satellites never preempt an already-open Core position.
A new Core entry may preempt the weakest Satellite only when point-in-time score advantage exceeds normalized switch cost plus training-frozen hysteresis.
Router horizon/hysteresis and Satellite subset are selected on pre-holdout training only.
Real-USDC holdout, full-window checks and later robustness are rejection-only and cannot retune router/subset.
No private credentials, cloud orders, automatic Paper/Live activation, or A09/A11 weakening.
acceptance: Step 5B router prototype produces deterministic HOLD/SWITCH evidence with no future-outcome decision leakage.
Step 5B shared 250-USDC reference account beats Core-only ending equity under baseline and stress, uses idle capacity productively and does not increase Core NO_FREE_SLOT blocks.
Selected Satellites have positive realized PnL under baseline/stress and remain short-horizon fillers.
Real-USDC holdout and full-three-year rejection checks pass without selection or retuning.
If Step 5B passes, Step 6 runs router-aware robustness for the frozen subset.
Step 7 hardens router semantics/state transitions; Step 8 proves scale invariance/dynamic allocation; Step 9 proves Backtest/UI/Paper/Trial/Live parity; Step 10 D14/A01-A11; Step 11 promotion.
active_mission.step5_result: Conservative no-router replay completed successfully but failed portfolio gate because profitable NEAR/AAVE filler trades blocked stronger later Core opportunities; router dependency proven.
